blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **вечер → вечер** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  **весь → весь** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with вечер). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. вечер · вечера · вечеру · вечер · вечером · вечере; pl. вечера · вечеров · вечерам · вечера · вечерами · вечерах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (та ночь, acc. sg.) было облачно.
exercises.why: **ночь → ночь** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь — declines like DLI's часть: A. часть. Ending -ь → -ь.  **тот → ту** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with ночь). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новая: A. новую. Ending -та → -у (the stem changes: т-).  Declension: sg. ночь · ночи · ночи · ночь · ночью · ночи; pl. ночи · ночей · ночам · ночи · ночами · ночах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Прилет самолета в Гонолулу намечен на ___ (завтрашнее утро, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The airplane is scheduled to arrive at Honolulu tomorrow morning.
exercises.why: **утро → утро** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о — declines like DLI's окно: A. окно. Ending -о → -о.  **завтрашний → завтрашнее** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with утро). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ее → -ее.  Declension: sg. утро · утра · утру · утро · утром · утре; pl. утра · утр · утрам · утра · утрами · утрах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Если вдуматься, дожди шли ___ (целая неделя, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Come to think of it, it has been raining for a week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я — declines like DLI's тётя: A. тётю. Ending -я → -ю.  **целый → целую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with неделю). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новая: A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Так говорили в ___ (шестидесятый год, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: People said so in the sixties.
exercises.why: **год → годы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural годы; declines like DLI's слова (hard stem): A. слова. Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  **шестидесятый → шестидесятые** (acc. pl., agreeing with годы). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новые: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ые → -ые.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ты не поедешь в Боснию на ___ (каникулы, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: You aren't going to Bosnia on vacation.
exercises.why: **каникулы → каникулы** (acc. pl.). Plural-only, inanimate; nominative plural каникулы; declines like DLI's слова (hard stem): A. слова. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. — · — · — · — · — · —; pl. каникулы · каникул · каникулам · каникулы · каникулами · каникулах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том выиграл в лотерею, но через ___ (год, acc. sg.) разорился.
exercises.prompt: Tom won the lottery, but went bankrupt a year later.
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я отниму у тебя всего ___ (минута, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I'll just take a minute of your time.
exercises.why: **минута → минуту** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. минута · минуты · минуте · минуту · минутой · минуте; pl. минуты · минут · минутам · минуты · минутами · минутах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Уверен, в ___ (близкая неделя, acc. sg.) мы отобьём город.
exercises.prompt: I'm certain we're retaking the city within a week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я — declines like DLI's тётя: A. тётю. Ending -я → -ю.  **близкий → ближайшую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with неделю). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русская: A. русскую. Ending -ая → -жайшую (the stem changes: бли-).  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Нам придётся удвоить наш бюджет на ___ (следующий год, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: We'll have to double our budget for next year.
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  **следующий → следующий** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with год). Adjective type IV, sibilant (after ж, ч, ш, щ) — declines like DLI's хороший: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ий → -ий.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.
